answer: Suppose agents sell dune surveys, sable illustrations and sonnet critiques. Allocate a fixed reward pool by escrowed capital, with no signup bonus or minimum payment per account. Validators total each key's locked funds and calculate exact proportional shares; dividing one deposit among aliases cannot raise its combined payout. A farm must lock additional capital to gain weight, bearing borrowing or opportunity costs even in parallel. This assumes enforceable escrow and no rounding windfalls. Rich coalitions can dominate; newcomers can begin with small deposits.
